WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly,
    MIN(monthly_revenue_millions) AS min_monthly
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  max_monthly,
  min_monthly,
  ROUND(max_monthly - min_monthly, 2) AS diff
FROM stats

WITH product_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY traffic_source, date
),
max_daily AS (
  SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) AS max_daily_revenue_millions
  FROM product_hits
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK) AS week_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY week_start
),
max_weekly AS (
  SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) AS max_weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM weekly_revenue
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month_start
),
max_monthly AS (
  SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  (SELECT max_daily_revenue_millions FROM max_daily) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT max_weekly_revenue_millions FROM max_weekly) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT max_monthly_revenue_millions FROM max_monthly) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_device AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.device.deviceCategory,
    s.date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND s.totals.transactions > 0
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.fullVisitorId ORDER BY s.date ASC) = 1
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
JOIN first_txn_device ft_device ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft_device.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
  AND ft_device.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
ORDER BY fv.fullVisitorId

SELECT nppes_provider_state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM (
  SELECT nppes_provider_state, drug_name, SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claims,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nppes_provider_state ORDER BY SUM(total_claim_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY nppes_provider_state

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
  GROUP BY _TABLE_SUFFIX, state
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    state,
    event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT 
  state,
  SUM(event_count) AS total_events
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 1000
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, s.name, s.usaf, s.wban, COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE s.state = 'WA'
    AND g.prcp > 0 
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn, s.name, s.usaf, s.wban
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, s.name, s.usaf, s.wban, COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE s.state = 'WA'
    AND g.prcp > 0 
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn, s.name, s.usaf, s.wban
)
SELECT a.stn, a.name, a.rainy_days_2023, b.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 a
JOIN rainy_2022 b ON a.stn = b.stn AND a.name = b.name
WHERE a.rainy_days_2023 > 150
  AND a.rainy_days_2023 < b.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY a.name

WITH daily_prcp AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    SUM(value) / 10.0 as total_precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND mflag IS NULL
    AND qflag IS NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.date,
    dp.total_precip_mm,
    CASE WHEN dp.total_precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_category,
    COALESCE(dt.num_trips, 0) as num_trips
  FROM daily_prcp dp
  LEFT JOIN daily_trips dt ON dp.date = dt.trip_date
)
SELECT 
  weather_category,
  AVG(num_trips) as avg_daily_trips
FROM combined
GROUP BY weather_category

WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    starttime,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id as end_station_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120 THEN 1
      WHEN next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as is_group_trip
  FROM same_station
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    SUM(is_group_trip) as group_trips
  FROM trip_groups
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id, 
      end_station_name,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.end_station_id,
    sn.end_station_name,
    gc.group_trips,
    tc.total_trips_ending,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trips, tc.total_trips_ending) as proportion,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trips, tc.total_trips_ending) DESC) as rn
  FROM group_counts gc
  JOIN total_counts tc ON gc.end_station_id = tc.end_station_id
  JOIN station_names sn ON gc.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id
)
SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name, group_trips, total_trips_ending, proportion
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY proportion DESC

WITH top_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(AVG(start_station_latitude), 3) as start_lat_3,
    ROUND(AVG(start_station_longitude), 3) as start_lon_3,
    ROUND(AVG(end_station_latitude), 3) as end_lat_3,
    ROUND(AVG(end_station_longitude), 3) as end_lon_3,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
    AND tripduration > 0
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_by_route AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat_3,
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon_3,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat_3,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon_3,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE dropoff_datetime IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
  tr.start_station_name,
  tr.end_station_name,
  tr.avg_bike_duration,
  ts.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
JOIN taxi_by_route ts 
  ON tr.start_lat_3 = ts.start_lat_3 
  AND tr.start_lon_3 = ts.start_lon_3
  AND tr.end_lat_3 = ts.end_lat_3
  AND tr.end_lon_3 = ts.end_lon_3
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ts.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    z.borough AS pickup_borough,
    CASE WHEN t.total_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100, t.total_amount) END AS tip_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` z
    ON t.pickup_location_id = z.zone_id
  WHERE
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(t.pickup_datetime, DAY) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01') AND TIMESTAMP('2016-01-07')
    AND TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(t.dropoff_datetime, DAY) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01') AND TIMESTAMP('2016-01-07')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
)
SELECT
  pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS no_tip_percentage
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_borough IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pickup_borough
ORDER BY no_tip_percentage DESC

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
stations_with_ada_entrances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
    AND s.station_lat = e.station_lat
    AND s.station_lon = e.station_lon
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE
    AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
),
ada_station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS ada_stations
  FROM stations_with_ada_entrances
  GROUP BY borough_name
)
SELECT 
  b.borough_name,
  b.total_stations,
  COALESCE(a.ada_stations, 0) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(a.ada_stations, 0), b.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM station_counts b
LEFT JOIN ada_station_counts a
  ON b.borough_name = a.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    start_date,
    duration_sec / 60.0 AS duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    year_month,
    duration_min,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date ASC, trip_id ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date DESC, trip_id DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM trips
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    year_month,
    (SELECT duration_min FROM ranked r1 WHERE r1.year_month = ranked.year_month AND r1.rn_asc = 1) AS first_duration_min,
    (SELECT duration_min FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.year_month = ranked.year_month AND r2.rn_desc = 1) AS last_duration_min
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
  fl.year_month,
  fl.first_duration_min,
  fl.last_duration_min,
  MIN(t.duration_min) AS lowest_duration_min,
  MAX(t.duration_min) AS highest_duration_min
FROM first_last fl
JOIN trips t ON fl.year_month = t.year_month
GROUP BY fl.year_month, fl.first_duration_min, fl.last_duration_min
ORDER BY fl.year_month

WITH latest_per_region AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name AS region_name,
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    t.member_gender,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s 
    ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r 
    ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
)
SELECT region_name, trip_id, duration_sec, start_date, start_station_name, member_gender
FROM latest_per_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
crime_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as crime_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` c
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGFROM(c.location))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  sc.neighborhood,
  sc.station_count,
  cc.crime_count
FROM station_counts sc
JOIN crime_counts cc ON sc.neighborhood = cc.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood

WITH age_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under_25,
    SUM(population) AS total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2017
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  country_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_under_25, total_pop) * 100 AS pct_under_25
FROM age_data
ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT country_name, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10') AND aggregation_level = 0 AND subregion1_code IS NULL AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000 AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California'),
    (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%')
  ) * 1000 as vaccine_sites_per_1000_people

SELECT bdr.country_name, bdr.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` bdr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` cna
  ON bdr.country_code = cna.country_code
WHERE bdr.year = 2017
  AND cna.country_area > 500
ORDER BY bdr.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH tournament_games AS (
    -- Historical tournament games 2014 onwards (win rows)
    SELECT 
        season,
        'win' AS label,
        win_seed AS seed,
        win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
        lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
        lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
    FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
    WHERE season >= 2014
    UNION ALL
    -- Historical tournament games 2014 onwards (loss rows)
    SELECT 
        season,
        'loss' AS label,
        lose_seed AS seed,
        lose_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
        win_seed AS opponent_seed,
        win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
    FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
    WHERE season >= 2014
    UNION ALL
    -- 2018 tournament results
    SELECT 
        season,
        label,
        seed,
        school_ncaa,
        opponent_seed,
        opponent_school_ncaa
    FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
)
SELECT 
    tg.season,
    tg.label,
    tg.seed,
    tg.school_ncaa,
    tg.opponent_seed,
    tg.opponent_school_ncaa,
    fe.pace_rank,
    fe.poss_40min AS pace_stat,
    fe.pace_rating,
    fe.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank,
    fe.pts_100poss AS eff_stat,
    fe.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating,
    fe_opp.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
    fe_opp.poss_40min AS opp_pace_stat,
    fe_opp.pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rank AS opp_eff_rank,
    fe_opp.pts_100poss AS opp_eff_stat,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rating AS opp_eff_rating,
    fe_opp.pace_rank - fe.pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
    fe_opp.poss_40min - fe.poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
    fe_opp.pace_rating - fe.pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rank - fe.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
    fe_opp.pts_100poss - fe.pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rating - fe.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM tournament_games tg
JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe 
    ON tg.school_ncaa = fe.team AND tg.season = fe.season
JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp 
    ON tg.opponent_school_ncaa = fe_opp.team AND tg.season = fe_opp.season
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  demographic_group,
  ROUND(growth_rate_percentage_points, 1) AS growth_rate
FROM (
  SELECT 
    'Asian' AS demographic_group,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2022 THEN race_asian END) - MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2014 THEN race_asian END)) * 100 AS growth_rate_percentage_points
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black' AS demographic_group,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2022 THEN race_black END) - MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2014 THEN race_black END)) * 100 AS growth_rate_percentage_points
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2022 THEN race_hispanic_latinx END) - MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2014 THEN race_hispanic_latinx END)) * 100 AS growth_rate_percentage_points
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Native American' AS demographic_group,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2022 THEN race_native_american END) - MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2014 THEN race_native_american END)) * 100 AS growth_rate_percentage_points
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'White' AS demographic_group,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2022 THEN race_white END) - MAX(CASE WHEN report_year = 2014 THEN race_white END)) * 100 AS growth_rate_percentage_points
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'US women' AS demographic_group,

SELECT 
  a.id as answer_id,
  aq.reputation as answerer_reputation,
  a.score as answer_score,
  a.comment_count as answer_comment_count,
  q.tags as question_tags,
  q.score as question_score,
  q.answer_count as question_answer_count,
  aqk.reputation as asker_reputation,
  q.view_count as question_view_count,
  q.comment_count as question_comment_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` aq ON a.owner_user_id = aq.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` aqk ON q.owner_user_id = aqk.id
WHERE q.accepted_answer_id = a.id
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.creation_date) = 2016
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM q.creation_date) = 1
  AND q.tags LIKE '%javascript%'
  AND (q.tags LIKE '%xss%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cross-site%' OR q.tags LIKE '%exploit%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cybersecurity%')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.creation_date) = 2016
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.creation_date) = 1

WITH answer_tags AS (
  SELECT 
    a.id as answer_id,
    q.tags,
    a.creation_date as answer_creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07 00:00:00')
),
exploded_tags AS (
  SELECT 
    answer_id,
    tag,
    answer_creation_date
  FROM answer_tags,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) as tag
  WHERE tag != ''
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    v.post_id as answer_id,
    v.vote_type_id,
    COUNT(*) as vote_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v
  WHERE v.post_id IN (SELECT answer_id FROM answer_tags)
    AND v.vote_type_id IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY v.post_id, v.vote_type_id
)
SELECT 
  et.tag,
  SUM(CASE WHEN av.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 10 * av.vote_count ELSE 0 END) 
    + SUM(CASE WHEN av.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 15 * av.vote_count ELSE 0 END) as total_score
FROM exploded_tags et
LEFT JOIN answer_votes av ON et.answer_id = av.answer_id
GROUP BY et.tag
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH c13 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) = 1
),
c17 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) = 1
),
c11 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) = 1
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone 
  FROM c13 
  JOIN c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo AS case_reference,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  k.CloneShort AS karyotype_short,
  c13.ChrOrd AS chr13_ChOrd,
  c13.Start AS chr13_Start,
  c13.`End` AS chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd AS chr17_ChOrd,
  c17.Start AS chr17_Start,
  c17.`End` AS chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd AS chr11_ChOrd,
  c11.Start AS chr11_Start,
  c11.`End` AS chr11_End
FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` k ON mc.RefNo = k.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = k.InvNo AND mc.Clone = k.CloneNo
JOIN c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone
JOIN c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone
JOIN c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value,
    a.standard_type,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL 
    AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.pchembl_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
heavy_atom_molecules AS (
  SELECT molregno, CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29`
  WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL 
    AND heavy_atoms != ''
    AND CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT fa.*, h.heavy_atoms
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN heavy_atom_molecules h ON fa.molregno = h.molregno
),
assay_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_activities,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) AS dup_activities
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING total_activities < 5 AND dup_activities < 2
),
valid_activities AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN assay_counts ac ON f.assay_id = ac.assay_id AND f.standard_type = ac.standard_type
),
valid_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id FROM valid_activities
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    d.doc_id,
    d.journal,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.year AS INT64), 1970) AS year,
    CAST(d.first_page AS INT64) AS first_page,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, COALESCE(CAST(d.year AS INT64), 1970) ORDER BY CAST(d.first_page AS INT64)) AS pct_rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM valid_docs)
    AND d.year IS NOT NULL AND d.year != ''
),
doc_pub_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year AS pub_year,
    CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', 
           LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 11) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
           LPAD(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date
  FROM doc_dates
),
compound_smiles AS (
  SELECT molregno, canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29`
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    v1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    v2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    v1.assay_id,
    v1.standard_type,
    v1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    v2.molregno AS molregno_2,
    v1.standard_value AS sv1,
    v2.standard_value AS sv2,
    v1.standard_relation AS sr1,
    v2.standard_relation AS sr2,
    v1.heavy_atoms AS ha1,
    v2.heavy_atoms AS ha2,
    v1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    v2.doc_id AS doc_id_2
  FROM valid_activities v1
  JOIN valid_activities v2 
    ON v1.assay_id = v2.assay_id 
    AND v1.standard_type = v2.standard_type
    AND v1.activity_id < v2.activity_id
    AND v1.molregno != v2.molregno
),
paired_with_details AS (
  SELECT 
    p.activity_id_1,
    p.activity_id_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    p.sv1,
    p.sv2,
    p.sr1,
    p.sr2,
    p.ha1,
    p.ha2,
    p.doc_id_1,
    p.doc_id_2,
    cs1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
    cs2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
    CASE WHEN p.ha1 >= p.ha2 THEN p.ha1 ELSE p.ha2 END AS max_heavy_atoms,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 = p.sv2 THEN 'no-change'
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 > p.sv2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 < p.sv2 THEN 'increase'
      ELSE 'no-change'
    END AS change_type,
    CASE WHEN p.doc_id_1 >= p.doc_id_2 THEN p.doc_id_1 ELSE p.doc_id_2 END AS highest_doc_id,
    dp1.pub_date AS pub_date_1,
    dp2.pub_date AS pub_date_2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN compound_smiles cs1 ON p.molregno_1 = cs1.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_smiles cs2 ON p.molregno_2 = cs2.molregno
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dp1 ON p.doc_id_1 = dp1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dp2 ON p.doc_id_2 = dp2.doc_id
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  max_heavy_atoms,
  CASE WHEN pub_date_1 >= pub_date_2 THEN pub_date_1 ELSE pub_date_2 END AS latest_pub_date,
  highest_doc_id,
  change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, smiles_1, activity_id_2, smiles_2)))) AS mmp_delta_uuid
FROM paired_with_details
ORDER BY activity_id_1, activity_id_2

WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year
),
cat_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    yt.year,
    t5.minor_category,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.value) / yt.total_crimes, 2) as percentage_share
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t5 ON c.minor_category = t5.minor_category
  JOIN yearly_totals yt ON c.year = yt.year
  WHERE c.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016
  GROUP BY yt.year, t5.minor_category, yt.total_crimes
)
SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Other Theft' THEN percentage_share END) AS other_theft,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN percentage_share END) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs' THEN percentage_share END) AS possession_of_drugs,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling' THEN percentage_share END) AS burglary_in_a_dwelling,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Assault with Injury' THEN percentage_share END) AS assault_with_injury
FROM cat_shares
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH RECURSIVE month_offsets AS (
  SELECT 1 as month_num
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month_num + 1 FROM month_offsets WHERE month_num < 220
),
user_months AS (
  SELECT 
    `by` as user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE `by` IS NOT NULL AND `by` != '' AND timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-11')
  GROUP BY `by`, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH)
),
user_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
    COUNT(*) as active_months_count
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 
    us.user_id,
    us.first_month,
    us.last_month,
    us.active_months_count,
    DATE_ADD(us.first_month, INTERVAL (mo.month_num - 1) MONTH) as generated_month,
    mo.month_num as month_number
  FROM user_stats us
  CROSS JOIN month_offsets mo
  WHERE DATE_ADD(us.first_month, INTERVAL (mo.month_num - 1) MONTH) <= us.last_month
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    am.user_id,
    am.month_number,
    am.generated_month
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN user_months um ON am.user_id = um.user_id AND am.generated_month = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.activity_month IS NULL
),
max_gap_month AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(month_number) as max_gap_month_number
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT user_id, max_gap_month_number
FROM max_gap_month
WHERE max_gap_month_number >= 214
ORDER BY max_gap_month_number DESC

WITH pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1402138.5184246691'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    page_title,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(page_location, r'[^/]+') AS segments,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(page_location, r'[^/]+')) AS num_segments
  FROM pages
),
with_replaced AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    page_title,
    num_segments,
    segments,
    IF(num_segments >= 4, segments[OFFSET(3)], '') AS seg4,
    IF(num_segments >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '') AS seg5,
    IF(num_segments >= 1, segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], '') AS last_seg,
    IF(num_segments >= 4, REPLACE(segments[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' '), '') AS seg4_clean,
    IF(num_segments >= 5, REPLACE(segments[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' '), '') AS seg5_clean
  FROM segmented
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    page_title,
    num_segments,
    seg4,
    seg5,
    last_seg,
    seg4_clean,
    seg5_clean,
    (LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%accessories%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%apparel%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%brands%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%campus collection%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%drinkware%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%electronics%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%google redesign%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%lifestyle%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%nest%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%notebooks journals%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%office%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%shop by brand%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%small goods%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%stationery%' 
      OR LOWER(seg4_clean) LIKE '%wearables%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%accessories%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%apparel%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%brands%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%campus collection%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%drinkware%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%electronics%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%google redesign%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%lifestyle%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%nest%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%notebooks journals%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%office%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%shop by brand%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%small goods%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%stationery%' 
      OR LOWER(seg5_clean) LIKE '%wearables%') AS has_category,
    (seg4 LIKE '%+%') AS seg4_has_plus,
    (seg5 LIKE '%+%') AS seg5_has_plus,
    (last_seg LIKE '%+%') AS last_seg_has_plus
  FROM with_replaced
)
SELECT 
  page_title AS page_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN num_segments >= 5 
      AND has_category 
      AND NOT seg4_has_plus 
      AND NOT seg5_has_plus 
    THEN 'PLP'
    WHEN num_segments >= 5 
      AND has_category 
      AND last_seg_has_plus 
    THEN 'PDP'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS page_type
FROM classified
GROUP BY page_title, page_type
ORDER BY 
  CASE page_type WHEN 'PDP' THEN 1 WHEN 'PLP' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  page_name

-- Final query: Find the cohort with highest 4th week retention rate
WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(first_session_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) as cohort_week_monday
  FROM user_first_session
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) as session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort_week_monday
  FROM user_cohort
),
cohort_4th_week AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_week_monday, INTERVAL 21 DAY) as week4_start,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_week_monday, INTERVAL 27 DAY) as week4_end
  FROM cohort_weeks
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_week_monday,
    COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id) as cohort_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN usd.session_date >= c4w.week4_start AND usd.session_date <= c4w.week4_end 
      THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
    END) as retained_users
  FROM user_cohort uc
  JOIN cohort_4th_week c4w ON uc.cohort_week_monday = c4w.cohort_week_monday
  LEFT JOIN user_session_dates usd ON uc.user_pseudo_id = usd.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_week_monday
)
SELECT 
  cohort_week_monday as cohort_date
FROM retention
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(retained_users, cohort_size) DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Let me use string-based date arithmetic
-- event_date is in YYYYMMDD format
WITH first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date as first_quickplay_date,
    event_name as quickplay_event_type
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ASC) = 1
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    fq.user_pseudo_id,
    fq.quickplay_event_type,
    fq.first_quickplay_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'session_start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as had_session_start
  FROM first_quickplay fq
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fq.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) BETWEEN DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fq.first_quickplay_date), INTERVAL 8 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fq.first_quickplay_date), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  GROUP BY fq.user_pseudo_id, fq.quickplay_event_type, fq.first_quickplay_date
)
SELECT 
  quickplay_event_type,
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(had_session_start) as retained_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(had_session_start), COUNT(*)) as retention_rate
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
